The '''Spirit of the Fire''' was a spiritual being in [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanian]] tradition. This spirit could be contacted by the [[City/Legends|village]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] through means of a [[Fire/Legends|bonfire]].
